notes: Cover letter's ICP-Brasil digital signature stamp: pdftotext -layout merges the rotated/boxed stamp graphic with the surrounding column text into a garbled 5-line block (signer's ID certificate number, timestamp with -03'00' offset), followed by the signer's name and role on their own lines. All removed as identification of who signed (AC). 'MHS' is a reviewer-initials rubric repeated standalone on every page (per-page identification of who checked the page).
